notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Heya! I managed to fix some bugs that have been reported.

- The 100% Clean Effect and accompanying Achievement in Area 6 (the second sand/desert area) would not always work due to bottles clipping out of the level. 
- Some sound effects not linked to sound level settings.
- Adjusted some credits.

Unfortunately I wasn't able to fix all the reported bugs at this time. 
Depending on the complexity, it will have to wait until a later patch.

If you find any bugs, be sure to report them in the '#bugs' channel on the Discord!
https://discord.gg/spilled


Thank you for an amazing launch so far.

- Lente

notes.title: New Spilled! Demo - Coming 5th of July: The Graphics Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Thank you for keeping up with Spilled!

I have something exciting coming, a big update to the free demo of Spilled! here on Steam :)

It will go live on Friday the 5th of July at 10am CEST. That's in a little more than a week!

Check out these cool new graphics, thanks to Tech Artist @starbi_dev

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428031/65b801b14f4b9d77cd7ed0a082deb7670dd26129.jpg

And the new trailer on Youtube:

[previewyoutube=6DEt2Yw8GrM;full][/previewyoutube]

I'd love to remind you when the new demo drops. Come join my Discord!

https://discord.gg/spilled

---

The game has already grown to an insane 39,500 wishlists. It is unbelievable (literally, I can't really wrap my head around it)

I am so happy the Kickstarter went well and that I was able to invest into the game, by hiring this Tech Artist for instance. 

I am so excited for the future of Spilled!

Thank you,

- Lente

notes.title: Wildfires and Dolphins - Development Update
notes.notes:
Hey there! I just want to share this little update with you :)

In area 5 of the game, you'll be able to put out wildfires!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428031/52dd628353d7db69e021a25b6429477db4ad2145.gif

Once you've cleaned up most of the area, dolphins will appear! They occasionally jump out of the water :)
